hook.title: THE SILVER BRIDGE COLLAPSE
lines: December 15, 1967, about 5 p.m. The Silver Bridge falls into the Ohio River. 46 people die.
It began with a crack an eighth of an inch deep, inside one joint of its chain.
No inspection of the day could have found it.
